paper.title: Origins of complex organic molecules in L1551 IRS 5: Interplay of thermal heating and accretion shocks

images.note: Peak-intensity (moment 8) map of the CH3OH 216.9 GHz (E_up = 55 K) emission toward L1551 IRS 5, overlaid with 0.9 mm continuum contours. Labels mark the spectral extraction positions a (north), b (south), c (east), d (west) rims of the northern circumstellar disk, w (CH3OH western extension) and s (Source S spot). 20 au scale bar. Panel is the left half of the paper Fig. 2 (right half is the velocity map, which is out of scope).

paper.title: Massive Compact Disks around FU Orionis-type Young Eruptive Stars Revealed by ALMA

notes: Class I protobinary in Taurus; ALMA 1.3mm continuum resolves both circumstellar disks plus the circumbinary ring (Cruz-Saenz de Miera et al. 2019, arXiv:1908.04649). Distance adopted from Taurus association (~147 pc, Galli et al. 2019).
